summary: A.H. Robins sold the untested Dalkon Shield IUD to millions of American women from 1971, causing deadly infections, then dumped unsterilized stock on the Global South through a USAID population control program.

evidence.note: A.H. Robins launches the Dalkon Shield in 1971
Robins declares bankruptcy in 1985 under the weight of judgments
by 1986 only one IUD brand remains on the US market
host reveals the series is really about the population control movement
origins traced to anti-Chinese immigration panic of the late 1800s, 1877 onward
long segment on Chinese exclusion, immigration barriers and racial statistics
extended segment on Margaret Sanger and her eugenic views
Ravenholt approves bulk purchase of unsterilized shields for overseas aid
USAID high-estrogen pill distribution harms women in Bangladesh
earlier experimental IUDs used in rural India and Pakistan in the 1960s
shield still offered at a Nairobi family planning clinic in 1979
2009 billionaire meeting and 2020 Sierra Club repudiation carry story to present

notes: Part 1 is the Dalkon Shield; part 2 pivots to the population control movement, so both are primary. Primary theme could equally be eugenics-scientific-racism. Overseas harm spanned 42 countries; setting lists those with real airtime (Ethiopia, Guatemala only named in passing). Ravenholt death year from general knowledge, please verify. Covered span starts at the 1877 anti-Chinese mobilisation; the 1860s US pressure on China is a brief mention.
